messages:
jenna: Heads-up: auditor wants a compact handback showing the emergency keystore access that occurred 2025-04-02 03:12 UTC. They asked for the approval timeline, who invoked the key, and a verifiable signed export of KMS audit entries. Need by EOD.
marc_oncall: I was paged for the incident and approved temporary escalation under our emergency access playbook. Ticket IT-8865 has the approval record and Slack call notes.
dev-lee: The hotfix deploy required decrypt of the config blob using cryptoKey 'prod/llm-key' by service-account-build@redwood. I can add the deploy CI job log.
secbot: evidence-pack: started bundle job ev-20250402-021; collecting artifacts: ticket/IT-8865, ci-job-log, kms-audit-lines, gke-audit-excerpt. Progress: 0/4.
auditor_sam: For traceability they need: 1) evidence of emergency authorization (signed/dated), 2) KMS decrypt entries with principal and request payload hash, 3) chain to the deployed commit. Also map to SOC2 CC-4.1 and ISO A.9.4.
ops-ryan: I'll export the KMS audit events for that 1-hour window and sign. Using our GPG key ops@redwood.com. Command: 
```bash
# export KMS decrypts
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="cloud_kms_key" AND protoPayload.methodName="Decrypt" AND timestamp>="2025-04-02T02:00:00Z" AND timestamp<="2025-04-02T04:00:00Z"' --format=json > kms-decrypt-20250402.json
# sign
gpg --local-user ops@redwood.com --armor --output kms-decrypt-20250402.json.asc --detach-sign kms-decrypt-20250402.json
# upload
aws s3 cp kms-decrypt-20250402.json s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2025-04-02/
aws s3 cp kms-decrypt-20250402.json.asc s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2025-04-02/
```
marc_oncall: Approval artifact is in IT-8865 with Yammer-signed acknowledgement by me and the product manager. I'll fetch the signed PDF and attach.
dev-lee: CI job is here: https://ci.redwood/builds/5521 and the commit is services/config@c7e5b21. I'll include the job log snippet showing successful decrypt step. Snippet: 
```
[03:12:14Z] gcloud kms decrypt --location=global --keyring=prod --key=llm-key --ciphertext-file=config.enc --plaintext-file=config.json --project=redwood-prod
[03:12:15Z] Decrypt succeeded for service-account-build@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
secbot: evidence-pack: progress 2/4 (ci-job-log, ticket/IT-8865 added).
auditor_sam: Can you provide checksum + signature for the exported file and tell me the retention policy? We require proof logs unaltered.
ops-ryan: Uploaded signed bundle: s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2025-04-02/emergency-access-bundle-1752223334.tar.gz (presigned link live for 7 days). SHA256: a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8g9h0i1j2k3l4m5n6o7p8q9r0s1t2
# I also notarized the hash in our internal timestamping service.
secbot: evidence-pack: progress 3/4 (kms-audit-lines added).
jenna: Mapping: IT-8865 approval -> SOC2 CC-4.1 (change control/emergency access), KMS audit export -> CC-6.1 (logging), ISO A.9.4 (user access review). Appendix in runbook shows artifact links.
marc_oncall: Note: retention policy is 395 days (logs-retention-policy-v2) and immutable snapshots are retained for 90 days in the evidence bucket before standard lifecycle.
dev-lee: I sanitized logs to redact sensitive blob contents but kept request hashes and principal emails. Will put full signed export in evidence bucket.
secbot: evidence-pack: completed. job ev-20250402-021 status=success artifacts=4
ops-ryan: Final bundle checksum verified, signing key fingerprint: 0x7F3A9C1B. Presigned URL: https://presigned.s3.redwood/evidence/2025-04-02/emergency-access-bundle-1752223334.tar.gz?X-Amz-Expires=604800
auditor_sam: Received. I will confirm with the auditor and may request a small sample of raw log lines for forensic validation. Thanks for the quick turnaround.
jenna: Thanks all — filing follow-up items in IT-8869 for retrospective and policy updates. :white_check_mark:
